EU.title: Transparency & Disclosure
EU.requirement: Provide required transparency notices and disclosures to relevant stakeholders.
EU.applies_if: AI/ML used in service delivery, automated decisioning, or user-facing AI.

EU.title: Risk Management System
EU.requirement: Maintain a documented risk management process covering foreseeable AI risks.
EU.applies_if: AI system development/deployment/operation is in scope.

EU.title: Data Governance
EU.requirement: Implement appropriate data governance measures (data quality, provenance, bias considerations).
EU.applies_if: AI model training/inference uses data that impacts outcomes.

EU.title: Human Oversight
EU.requirement: Ensure appropriate human oversight measures exist for AI outputs and decisions.
EU.applies_if: AI influences decisions with legal/material effects.

EU.title: Logging & Traceability
EU.requirement: Maintain logs/records enabling traceability and accountability of AI behavior.
EU.applies_if: AI systems are used in operational processes.

AU.title: Privacy & Data Handling
AU.requirement: Ensure personal information handling aligns with applicable privacy requirements and contractual protections.

AU.title: Security Controls
AU.requirement: Implement security controls (access control, incident response, encryption as appropriate).
AU.applies_if: Sensitive data or critical systems are involved.

AU.title: Incident/Breach Notification
AU.requirement: Define notification timelines and responsibilities for security/privacy incidents.
AU.applies_if: Data processing and security obligations exist.

AU.title: Record Keeping
AU.requirement: Maintain records supporting compliance and auditability (logs, decisions, approvals).
AU.applies_if: Regulated or sensitive processing is performed.
